scripts.pretest: bun run build:pptx-wasm && bun run build:vsdx-wasm && bun run build:fonts
scripts.build:pptx: bun run --filter '@betteroffice/pptx-i18n' build && bun run --filter '@betteroffice/pptx' build && bun run --filter '@betteroffice/pptx-react' build
scripts.build:vsdx: bun run --filter '@betteroffice/vsdx-i18n' build && bun run --filter '@betteroffice/vsdx' build && bun run --filter '@betteroffice/vsdx-react' build
scripts.build:xlsx: bun run --filter '@betteroffice/xlsx-i18n' build && bun run --filter '@betteroffice/xlsx' build && bun run --filter '@betteroffice/xlsx-react' build
scripts.build:packages: bun run build:fonts && bun run build:xlsx && bun run build:docx && bun run build:pptx && bun run build:vsdx
scripts.test: bun run build:xlsx-wasm && bun run build:docx-wasm && bun test --isolate packages apps/web/app apps/web/lib apps/demo/lib apps/fidelity/src scripts e2e
scripts.build:wasm: bun run build:xlsx-wasm && bun run build:docx-wasm && bun run build:pptx-wasm && bun run build:vsdx-wasm
scripts.pretest:e2e: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:fonts
scripts.pretest:e2e:record: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:fonts
scripts.pretest:e2e:compare: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:fonts
scripts.rust:check: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test && cargo test -p betteroffice-docx-edit --features wasm
scripts.publish:packages: bun run publish:crates && bun scripts/rewrite-workspace-deps.ts && changeset publish
scripts.release: bun run build:packages && bun run publish:packages
scripts.build:docx: bun run --filter '@betteroffice/docx-i18n' build && bun run --filter '@betteroffice/docx' build && bun run --filter '@betteroffice/docx-react' build
scripts.test:e2e:harness: bun test e2e/harness.test.ts e2e/suite.test.ts e2e/report.test.ts e2e/assertions.test.ts
scripts.pretest:e2e:browser: bun run build:packages && bun run --filter @betteroffice/desktop build
